goal: Detect the source language of a venue, city or category name before it is translated
expected_outcome: Each name gets the right source language (Greek, Russian or English); a typed decision answers confidently where it can and escalates the middle band, reported per language

goal: Decide whether a provider's localized text is genuinely in its expected language (English, Greek, Russian), so Greeklish or transliterated text is never published as that language
expected_outcome: Each payload gets the right verdict (genuine expected language or not), with Greek or Russian in Latin letters rejected and proper names accepted; reported per language
